title: DOM pinball made from live form controls
blurb: A 2D physics pinball table built from live HTML controls inside one drawable canvas. Bumpers are buttons that flash on impact, ramps are rotated range sliders you can tilt mid-flight, the diverter gate is a checkbox, the bonus trap is a <details> element, and the flippers are live buttons.
question: Can a 2D physics pinball table use real HTML form controls as its bumpers, tiltable ramps, gates, scoreboards and ball traps so collisions mutate the DOM and user taps on the controls change the physics mid-flight?
result: Not verified in Chromium yet. Six isolated live checks test bumper DOM mutations raising paint, rotated range slider hit boxes, checkbox gate toggles, script-opened details height changes, pivoted flipper clicks and context survival on your device.
